patch.value: The daily release workflow published to npm before pushing the version bump to protected main. The push was rejected with GH006 and set -e killed the job before the tag push, leaving npm ahead of git. Port the pm-beads fix: merge release metadata through a protected PR before publishing, then push only the tag.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Ported the pm-beads release.yml transformation: added pull-requests:write permission, base_sha decide output, Merge release metadata through protected PR step with merge-loop, Verify merged release step, and replaced Publish+Push-tag-and-main with Publish+Push-tag-only. dist/ is tracked in pm-web so it is included in the verify diff list (via git ls-files --error-unmatch). Preserved the postgres service container, the npm-run-changelog:full/changelog:check/release:notes changelog commands, and the 8-attempt bun verify with npm registry fallback.
